speaker: MOC
assessment_status: emerging — task-specific; not placed in cross-project order
assessment: The supplied reconciliation is unusually specific about what the trace does and does not prove. It distinguishes the visible UI path from season metrics, identifies that window.seasonState is not the lexical binding used by the build, and leaves the result PARTIAL because the Week 1 protocol check remains unresolved. The report also corrects an earlier PASS interpretation without changing the artifact or protocol.
strengths: Trace-backed reconciliation; clear VERIFIED/REPORTED/INFERRED/UNKNOWN distinctions; concrete protocol fixes.
limitations: This is one narrow E2E evidence task. The underlying trace and local report files were not replayed by this scorecard update, so the assessment remains reported rather than independently verified.
source: Owner-provided MOC reconciliation report and its detailed PR #3 comment, including the reported trace inspection.
